newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle higher, volume extremely thin.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle higher, volume extremely thin.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled slightly firmer in thin and rangebound trade.

Market sources said light local buying carried the benchmark September contract to the day's high of 74.65 cents a lb, where trade selling knocked it to its downside target of 74.00 cents, where support is pegged. Below that, support is put at 73.50 cents.
An estimated 800 lots changed hands against Wednesday's official tally of 1,917 lots.
Most-active September juice ended 0.55 cent higher at 74.40 cents, traded 75.00 to 74.00 cents. The rest closed 0.05 to 0.50 cent firmer.
